title: A screening's counts-only outcome (audit #57; the founder's rulings of 2026-10-20)
assertion: Written at submission, refusal, completion and failure by the database alone: stage, month, source, the channel computed from the medium and click kind, a listed campaign or other, bands of the row counts, whole-percent shares summing 97 to 100, the anomaly and dollar bands, the open band and the conversion; no name, email, ZIP, exact count, date or dollar figure; unlinked on expiry and replacement, then sealed; never deleted; two outcomes of a practice whose row differs by one claim line differ in no count
noFileReason: A screening outcome is written by the database from the rows the tests submit in memory; no file.
